claim_boundary: A pass establishes out-of-quire prediction of frozen text-state axes from publicly pretrained, foldout-aware complete-object representations under exact quire x Currier x section rematching. It still does not identify plaintext or image semantics. A failure closes this detector/SAM/DINO/topology route and its linear kernel map, not manually labeled iconographic correspondences.

parameters.state_axis_transform: train-page log1p character-transition counts; feature standardization; PCA; unit-variance axes
